citeAs: Merity, S., Xiong, C., Bradbury, J., & Socher, R. (2016). Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models. arXiv preprint arXiv:1609.07843.
creator: Stephen Merity, Caiming Xiong, James Bradbury, Richard Socher (MetaMind - A Salesforce Company)
description: A benchmark dataset for language modeling constructed using text extracted from Wikipedia Good and Featured articles, designed to evaluate how well language models can exploit longer contexts and deal with more realistic vocabularies.
name: WikiText
rai:dataCollection: Articles fitting the Good or Featured article criteria specified by editors on Wikipedia were selected. The text for each article was extracted using the Wikipedia API.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw text from Wikipedia mark-up, which includes a large number of macros used for metric conversion, abbreviations, language notation, and date handling.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Specific sections which primarily featured lists were removed. Minor bugs like sort keys and Edit buttons were removed. Mathematical formulae and LaTeX code were replaced with <formula> tokens. Normalization and tokenization were performed using the Moses tokenizer, slightly augmented to further split numbers. Words with a count below 3 were discarded and mapped to the <unk> token.
rai:dataUseCases: Language modeling, evaluating how well language models can exploit longer contexts and deal with more realistic vocabularies and larger corpora.
